extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from primary XML/PDF, supplementary PDF text, and source-data workbook inventory; automated pending-review scaffold claims replaced.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: F365 is presented as a polymyxin-derived lipopeptide designed to retain Lipid A/LPS interaction while reducing hydrophobicity at selected positions; this is structural/modeling context rather than direct activity proof by itself.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Modeling and design rationale are not normalized into a direct antimicrobial mechanism without assay support.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Supplementary outer-membrane permeabilization assays support that F365 can permeabilize P. aeruginosa outer membranes, with polymyxin B as comparator and Mg2+ reducing the effect.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: F365 and polymyxin B in P. aeruginosa outer-membrane assay

source_locator.locator: supplementary_text:Activity of F365 and polymyxin B in the outer membrane permeabilization assay; Supplementary Fig. 5a

mechanism_claims.limitations: Exact plotted concentration-response points are figure/source-data level and are not converted beyond the textual summary and source-data inventory.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Supplementary efflux inhibition assays using Leu-Nap hydrolysis support an F365-associated increase in cell-envelope/efflux-related readout in P. aeruginosa strains.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: F365 and polymyxin B in P. aeruginosa efflux assay

source_locator.locator: supplementary_text:Activity of F365 and polymyxin B in the efflux inhibition assay; Supplementary Fig. 5b

mechanism_claims.limitations: Efflux/readout interpretation is bounded to the reported assay and not promoted to a full molecular target assignment.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Transcriptomic data in A. baumannii and HK-2 cells provide context for membrane stress and renal-toxicity differentiation among polymyxins and F365/F287/F319, but remain omics context rather than a single direct molecular mechanism.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: F365, F287, F319, polymyxin B, colistin
mechanism_claims.limitations: No direct target enzyme/receptor is assigned from transcriptomics alone.
